head.title: Minimal PostgreSQL Playthrough E2E
head.teaser: A minimal PostgreSQL game for the browser play-through test.

text-scene.text: Welcome to the minimal PostgreSQL game.

select-scene.sql-solution: SELECT name FROM items ORDER BY id

manipulate-scene.sql-solution: UPDATE items SET collected = TRUE WHERE name = 'key'
manipulate-scene.sql-check: SELECT name, collected FROM items ORDER BY id

text-scene.text: You finished the minimal PostgreSQL game.
